rowA.text: Direction A — indigo band, light workspace, amber accent

legend.text: All example content mirrors the deterministic fixtures (project “fixture”, task “Three modules”, items a/b/c, built-in roles). Counts and stages are real backend fields; nothing shows percentages, estimates or model availability that the backend cannot measure. Controls that arrive in U2/U3 are drawn visibly unavailable.

chosen.text: Selected direction: A, with a denser two-column Overview.

rowU3.text: U3 — browser workflows and guided setup (extends Direction A; U1/U2 boards unchanged)

legendU3.text: U3 contracts drawn here: POST /projects with strict ProjectInput and preserved input on failure; one idempotency key per submission attempt, held until the outcome is known; mode/approve/cancel reuse the existing routes and bind to the displayed task version; the diff is read by task identity only, text-only, with unavailable/binary/truncated/empty told apart; setup reuses the terminal flow and never collects credentials or runs a paid test on its own.

rowU4.text: U4 — free disk space, embedded in the existing screens (no new page)

legendU4.text: Contract: GET /tasks/:id/cleanup-preview returns worktrees (path, size, uncommitted and untracked files), branches to delete and keep, run temp data and a digest; POST /tasks/:id/cleanup {digest, savePatch} recomputes ownership and the list and refuses with 409 when anything changed. A completed task's branch is always kept. Events and evidence are never deleted. Nothing is removed automatically.

rowU5.text: U5 — improvements taken from the Paperclip review: liveness rule, answer-only mode, visible cost; compaction added to U4

legendU5.text: Liveness rule: every unfinished task has a live path (engine activity), an explicit waiting path (a decision of yours) or a recovery path (a choice offered to you); anything else is shown as needing attention. Automatic retries are bounded (quota/capacity once, lost dispatch once) and tool calls are never replayed. Costs are provider-reported tokens summed per task and project; prices are optional configuration, never estimates. See docs/IMPROVEMENT_PLAN.md.

rowU6.text: U6 — Work tab as a team board: who is finished, who is working, who is left (design only, to be refined together)

legendU6.text: Two treatments on one page: the pipeline (plan → build → review → integrate → commit, with the members who do each stage) and the roster (Finished / Working now / Up next columns). "You" appears as a member whenever a decision is yours. Every value is a recorded run, event or checkpoint; durations are timestamp differences; nothing is estimated. Members the plan does not need are shown as not needed. No new backend field is required.
